title: You vs Zombies - playtest #2 is live
author: Traditional_Law5082
selftext:
Hi all -

  
I posted this earlier but somehow the text went missing ;)

  
So here goes again - I run an indie studio called 10six Games, a small team of 8 close friends who have all worked together for years now. Like a little rock band. My partner is my husband...he and I have been making games together since our days at Rockstar (he was a designer on bully, gta series) and I started 2K Games back then. Yes, many fun stories I can tell...

Anyhow, so we put the new studio together w our industry friends as we got excited about genAI on our last game. We wanted to figure out if there were novel things to be done that perhaps couldnt be done without genAI. The corner we stumbled upon was character creation - something which has gotten crazy complex over the years and so is a) daunting if you arent hardcore into editors and b) limited by the experience/bias/etc of the person creating it.

  
We realized that we could use genAI tools to train models in our art style (custom LoRAs hosted by Flux Klein), we could train systems in our game design and use Gemini and other genAI tech to give the AI very strict guidelines and limits to change those systems rapidly but balanced and fun because they are all human built systems.

That means in about 15 secs, a player can come in, give us a little bit of description in human language, and be playing. Currently you'll get to play through 8 story beats with the last one being a custom boss fight based on who you are.   
What changes? Art. Spells. Story. Dialogue. Enemies. Settings. Character class. Stat sheet.

**So this is something an infinitely large team couldnt do - customize on the fly, in runtime, this amount of content for a player's request. This, we think, is pretty magic.** 

Imagine being a kid in some obscure village our team hasn't heard of...say in Asia with a birthmark on your face, with a bully for a neighbor that you hate. Imagine if you only talk in Seussian rhymes too. And imagine you really like pink fluffy flippers. All of that, in seconds.

It's pretty mad that it works, we werent sure when we started 18 months ago. But it does. And by the time we launch later this year, what feels like a horde survival game will be a much more robust roguelite game with skill tree, loot system, and more. 

All wrapped in a crazy, sarcastically witty, time travel zombie slayer. Kill zombies, fix the timeline, save the world. Don't die.

**Playtest live here:** [**https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224660/YOU\_vs\_Zombies/**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224660/YOU_vs_Zombies/)

And please wishlist if you are a fan of what we're doing. And join our community on discord if you like so you can help us along the way. We're a very responsive team.

https://preview.redd.it/820y5khb646h1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=9cd09ae918bc45b2e82bf4b624e85c19cbe0f0fb

  
\- Susan (ceo, 10six Games)
